thread:
Sam (Acme): Hey team — noticed a big billing spike this morning and a ton of 400s from /v1/embeddings. Also saw intermittent 401s for the same API key. Payload here looks fine from our side but we recently updated our client lib. Any thoughts? cc @Lina (Support) 

Lina (Support): Thanks Sam — can you paste the exact request body and headers (no secrets) and approximate time range for the spike? Also paste any stack traces. :eyes: 

Sam (Acme): Pasting sanitized curl we used (timestamps ~2026-03-16T09:12):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"open-embed-medium","input":[["Pricing docs overview"]]}'

We expected single input, but the client wraps strings when batch parameter is true. We got a 400: "embedding shape mismatch". Billing shows lots of small batch calls too.

Marta (Infra): Hmm that payload has an extra nesting layer: input -> [ [ "..." ] ] rather than [ "..." ] or [[...],[...]]. Server logs around 2026-03-16T09:12:xx show repeated requests from the same IP with small intervals. Any retry logic on your side?

Sam (Acme): Yes our retry middleware detected 400s and retried twice with exponential backoff. But why 401s? We saw a few 401s at 09:13.

Noah (EngOncall): Putting logs in: our proxy rejected a subset of requests with 401 when token header was malformed (missing "Bearer "). I bet client lib tried an alternate auth path on retry (token refresh) and accidentally sent a wrong header for a handful of attempts. We also emit a metric when request payload has extra nesting and we map that to a 400 for embeddings. Combined effect = repeated retries -> amplified billing.

Sam (Acme): Ugh OK makes sense. Example Node snippet from them (buggy):

```js
// buggy client usage causing double-wrap
const payload = { model: 'open-embed-medium', input: [[text]] } // text is a string
fetch('/v1/embeddings', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload), headers })
```

They said the client wrapper also wraps when they pass an array vs string, so sometimes it becomes triple-nested.

Lina (Support): Thanks — two action items: 1) For immediate mitigation, add a server-side guard to return a single 400 without triggering client retries on detect-nested-array; 2) Provide customer fix guidance + ask them to disable auto-retries for 400s and ensure Authorization header includes "Bearer ".

Marta (Infra): Repro steps I used locally: send the extra-nested payload and we return: 400 Bad Request - embedding input must be shape [N] or [[N]] but got extra nesting. Log snippet: "BadRequest: embeddings input nested depth=3, expected <=2". Also observed throughput spike due to client's 3 retries within 5s.

BillingBot: Alert: unusual usage spike for Customer Acme between 2026-03-16T09:11 and 09:20. Estimated extra token units billed: 14,200. Invoice alert generated.

Sam (Acme): Is there any chance we can get a one-time credit? The extra billing was entirely caused by double-wrap + our retry behavior.

Noah (EngOncall): I'll escalate to billing but we need evidence. Lina, can you request the raw request_id headers from Sam for a few sample calls? That'll let us correlate logs to billing.

Lina (Support): Sam — can you provide 3 example request_ids + timestamps? If not, paste the full curl with headers (masking token). 

Sam (Acme): Provided two request-ids: req_0a1b2c3 and req_0a1b2c4 at 09:12:05 and 09:12:08. Also one 401 at 09:13:02 req_0a1b2c9.

Marta (Infra): Correlated. req_0a1b2c3/4 show nested payload and 400 responses. req_0a1b2c9 shows header 'Authorization: <REDACTED>' (missing Bearer) -> 401. Found retry loop in client's logs that retried 2x when status >= 400.

Noah (EngOncall): Quick fix deployed: server will now return 422 for nested-array-detected with "do_not_retry": true header in response body so well-behaved clients won't retry. Patch ID: deploy-embed-guard-20260316. Rollout 100% in 30s.

Lina (Support): Sent guidance to customer: 1) Remove extra nesting (input: ["..."] or inputs: [["..."],["..."]]) 2) Ensure auth header format: "Authorization: Bearer <key>" 3) Disable automatic retry on 4xx. Sample correct payload in Node: 

```js
// correct
const payload = { model: 'open-embed-medium', input: ['Pricing docs overview'] }
```

Sam (Acme): Confirmed after fix and disabling retries the errors stopped and billing stopped increasing. Thanks all. :pray:

BillingBot: Billing adjustment request created for Customer Acme referencing spike on 2026-03-16. Ticket #BILL-4821.

Lina (Support): Follow-up: we're going to add a short note in the embeddings docs about common client double-wrap mistakes and update the SDK to refuse to silently double-wrap inputs. Marta, can you add an alert rule to surface sudden small-batch spikes in the future?

Marta (Infra): Yep I'll create an alert (rule id: infra-embed-smallbatch-spike) to detect >200 small-batch requests per minute from single API key.

Noah (EngOncall): Closing loop: patched server, docs note, SDK change scheduled, billing ticket opened. Marking thread resolved unless Sam needs more.

Sam (Acme): All good here. Appreciate the fast turnaround! :rocket:
